title: WritebackFacts
description: The write-back decision record (E5, B37/D19): T6/S7's contract had no carrier — every cell the tool wrote AND every cell it refused, with the reason, so 'which of these did we touch?' is answerable by looking, never by re-deriving. The buyer's inbox original is never mutated; output_file is the copy under exports/writeback/. A refusal here is the system working (the pricing grid lands as refused_shape — B28(4)'s shape-skip rule reaching the exit door).

plan_sha256.description: The frozen plan this write-back obeyed — cells come only from what the pursuit plan names (T6).

draft_sha256.description: The exact envelope whose prose landed in cells.

confirmed_by.description: The human who confirmed the previewed diff (S7) — write-back never runs unconfirmed.

source_file.description: The buyer's file the copy was made FROM (inbox path + sha256 recorded by the artifact line).

output_file.description: The written copy under exports/writeback/ — the only file the tool touches.

cell.description: A1-style address from the slot's source_locator (the xlsx lane).

docx_anchor.description: The slot's heading anchor (the docx lane, P16/C8).

table_index.description: docx lane: body-order table index, re-derived from the digest-bound source (never a client echo).

decision.description: written = drafted prose landed; refused_shape = boolean/numeric/record/table/template_fill/none never take model prose (the pricing grid lives here); refused_unnamed = the plan names no such cell (T6); empty_no_prose = the slot stays honestly empty for the human (verify.py's state_if_not_offered posture); refused_no_cell = the docx slot has no addressable answer cell — its prose ships via the rendered response document, not write-back (P16/C8).

before.description: Cell value before (written cells only — the diff the human confirmed).
